traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills that are decurrent, close, yellowish to orange-brown, and bruising reddish-brown upon handling or aging
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are decurrent, close, yellowish to orange-brown, and bruising reddish-brown upon handling or aging

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Convex, often with a depressed center and an inrolled margin when young, smooth to slightly velvety, with colors ranging from reddish-brown to rusty-brown
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Convex, often with a depressed center and an inrolled margin when young, smooth to slightly velvety, with colors ranging from reddish-brown to rusty-brown

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Decurrent
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Decurrent

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, tapering towards the base, and of a similar or paler color than the cap, bruises reddish or brown when handled
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, tapering towards the base, and of a similar or paler color than the cap, bruises reddish or brown when handled

traits.label: Spore print

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal, most commonly associated with broadleaved trees, especially alders, it grows in mixed and broadleaf forests, favoring acidic soils

traits.text: Fruit body Up to 8–10 cm
